Class DefaultSchemaResolver

java.lang.Object
org.apache.pulsar.spring.core.DefaultSchemaResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
SchemaResolver, Aware, BeanClassLoaderAware
public class DefaultSchemaResolver extends Object implements SchemaResolver, BeanClassLoaderAware
Default schema resolver capable of handling basic message types.

Additional message types can be configured with addCustomSchemaMapping(Class, Schema).
